Naming children with this name is considered a significant way to pass down the stories and teachings of Yakub, and to show respect and admiration for his legacy.

The name "Yakub" is rooted in the belief that Allah (God) has the power to increase and bless us in all areas of our lives, just as He did for Prophet Yakub. It is a source of inspiration and encouragement to strive for growth and increase in our faith, character, and actions.
